caption:
Every service business has a pile of leads who never said no.

They said "let me think about it." "Send me a quote and I'll call you back." "Not right now, but maybe next month." Most owners follow up once, hear silence, and move on to the next lead.

That pile becomes the most expensive list in the business. Every name on it already raised a hand.

The fix: stop treating "not yet" like "no." Build a real cadence instead.

Day 1: quick check-in, no pressure
Day 3: answer the objection you heard
Day 7: share something useful, not a pitch
Day 14: direct offer with a reason to decide now
Day 30: last touch before you archive the lead

Black Arrow built this exact cadence into a free tool. The Follow-Up Builder writes the sequence and the messages for you, so the leads sitting in your notes app get worked instead of ignored.
